rha_dataset.paper_title: Rice Husk Ash (RHA) Based Concrete: Workability and Compressive Strength with Different Dosages and Curing Ages
rha_dataset.authors: Wagan, Memon A.H., Memon N.A., Memon F.T., Lashari
rha_dataset.rha_source_location: Local rice mill, Nawabshah, Pakistan; husk burnt in lab at low temperature (~200C, likely incomplete combustion)
rha_dataset.output_availability: Compressive strength tabulated at 1/3/7/28 days (Table 4); no flexural or split tensile tested
rha_dataset.value_source: Comp MPa verbatim from Table 4. Mix proportions given only as ratio 1:2:4 with w/c=0.5 (no kg/m3 reported) -> cement/agg kg/m3 left blank.
rha_dataset.notes: OPC reduced by weight of binder equal to RHA percentage. 7 batches B-1..B-7 at RHA 0/5/10/15/20/25/30%. w/c fixed 0.5. kg/m3 not reported. Note: 7-day comp values are lower than 3-day in the source table (reported as-is). RHA burnt at low temp (~200C) so reduced pozzolanic activity; strengths decline markedly beyond 10%.

rha_dataset.paper_title: Effect of Using Rice Husk Ash as Partial Replacement of Cement on Properties of Fresh and Hardened Concrete
rha_dataset.authors: Ajwad, Ahmad, Abdullah, Jaffar, Ilyas, Adnan
rha_dataset.country_region: Pakistan (Lahore; University of Management and Technology)
rha_dataset.rha_source_location: Brick/block kiln near Lahore, Pakistan; sieved (#4, #40) and ball-milled to ~600 m2/kg
rha_dataset.output_availability: Compressive (Table 4) and split-cylinder tensile (Table 5) tabulated at 3/7/28/56 days; flexural (modulus of rupture) only in Fig 12 (4-6 MPa range) -> left blank
rha_dataset.value_source: Comp & split MPa verbatim from Tables 4 & 5. kg/m3 per m3 from Table 6 (cement 345, fine 690, coarse 1380) with total binder held constant at 345 kg/m3; cement/RHA split computed per replacement level; water=0.6*345=207 kg/m3.
rha_dataset.notes: RHA 0/6/12/18/24% by weight of cement; w/b 0.6 constant; binder 345 kg/m3 constant. Cement/RHA per level: 0%->345/0; 6%->324.3/20.7; 12%->303.6/41.4; 18%->282.9/62.1; 24%->262.2/82.8. Reported 28d comp ~13.5 MPa (low for M15). Flexural ~4-6 MPa figure-only.
rha_dataset.evidence: Table 6 per-m3 quantities (raw 0%: cement 345 kg, fine 690 kg, coarse 1380 kg; 6%: cement 324.3 + RHA 20.7). Table 4 comp MPa 3/7/28/56d. Table 5 split MPa 3/7/28/56d. w/b 0.6.

rha_dataset.paper_title: Optimizing Compressive Strength Properties of Binary Blended Cement Rice Husk Concrete for Road Pavement
rha_dataset.authors: Fitriani, Ahmed, Olonade, Hyndman, Idris, Rosidawani
rha_dataset.country_region: Indonesia (Palembang, South Sumatra; Universitas Sriwijaya) / UK pavement mix standard
rha_dataset.rha_source_location: Rice mill at Gasing, South Sumatra, Indonesia; burnt at 700C for 1 hour
rha_dataset.material_type: Concrete for rigid road pavement (3 mix ratios) with superplasticizer
rha_dataset.output_availability: Compressive strength only in Figs 6-8; Strength Activity Index tabulated (Table 5). Only M1 control absolutes stated in text (M1-0: 7d 26.6, 28d 31.1 N/mm2). M2/M3 absolutes and all 56d values figure-only.
rha_dataset.value_source: kg/m3 verbatim from Table 3. M1 series comp at 7d/28d COMPUTED = stated M1-0 absolute x tabulated SAI (Table 5). M2, M3 and 56d strengths NOT recoverable from text -> left blank.
rha_dataset.notes: Portland Composite Cement (PCC). w/b 0.4 constant. SP Sika ViscoCrete-5930 at 150 mL/m3. RHA 0/2.5/5/7.5/10% replacing cement by weight, across 3 binder:sand:granite ratios (M1 1:1.56:1.64, M2 1:1.77:1.88, M3 1:2.07:2.17). M1-0 stated 7d=26.6, 28d=31.1 N/mm2 -> M1 series back-computed via SAI; M1 7d SAI 100/115.04/115.04/111.65/94.74; 28d SAI 100/108.68/111.58/100/97.11. M2/M3 mix proportions captured; their strengths and all 56-day strengths are figure-only (blank). 28-day pavement threshold 27.5 N/mm2.
rha_dataset.evidence: Table 3 per-m3 mix proportions (cement, RHA, sand, granite, water). Table 5 Strength Activity Index (%) at 7/28/56d. Text: M1-0 strength 26.6 (7d) -> 31.1 N/mm2 (28d, +17%).

rha_dataset.paper_title: Study on Slag-Rice Husk Ash based Alkali Activated Concrete
rha_dataset.country_region: India (Assam; Jorhat Engineering College / NIT Mizoram)
rha_dataset.rha_source_location: Agro-based biomass industry, Assam, India; ground in Los Angeles abrasion machine (15 or 30 min)
rha_dataset.material_type: OPC concrete with RHA (CM1 series, RHA fineness study) and plain OPC control (CM2)
rha_dataset.output_availability: Compressive strength tabulated at 7 and 28 days (Tables 7 and 11)
rha_dataset.value_source: Comp MPa verbatim from Table 7 (CM1) and Table 11 (CM2). CM1 proportions given only as 6-cube batch masses (Table 3), not kg/m3 -> CM1 cement/agg kg/m3 left blank. CM2 proportions in kg/m3 (Table 5).
rha_dataset.notes: CM1: OPC concrete, RHA fixed at 15% by weight of cement; variable is RHA grinding/fineness (FM0=0% control; FM1=raw RHA; FM2=15 min ground; FM3=30 min ground). Batch (6 cubes): cement 3.07 kg (FM0) / 2.61 kg (FM1-3), RHA 0.46 kg, FA 5.38, CA 8.56, water 1538 mL + 171 mL extra -> w/c ~0.50-0.56. CM2: separate plain OPC control mix, w/c 0.40. Companion alkali-activated (GGBS+RHA, no OPC) series recorded under paper_id 2022_05b.

mixes.other_additives: Raw RHA (no grinding), batch RHA 0.46 kg

rha_dataset.paper_title: Quantification of Hydration Products in Rice Husk Ash (RHA)-Blended Cement Concrete with Crumb Waste Rubber Tires (CWRT) and its Correlation with Mechanical Performance
rha_dataset.rha_source_location: Open-air burning (RHA-O), Philippines; ground in Los Angeles abrasion machine to ASTM C618 fineness
rha_dataset.material_type: RHA-blended cement concrete with crumb waste rubber tire (CWRT) as fine-aggregate replacement
rha_dataset.output_availability: Compressive and splitting tensile (28 days) only in Fig 6; only split tensile R17.5C0 = 3.06 MPa stated in text (+31.2% vs control -> control 2.33 MPa derived). Comp absolutes not stated -> blank.
rha_dataset.value_source: kg/m3 verbatim from Table 3. Split tensile R17.5C0 = 3.06 MPa verbatim; control R0C0 split = 2.33 COMPUTED (3.06/1.312). All compressive strengths and remaining split values are figure-only -> blank.
rha_dataset.notes: Concrete per ACI 211.1 at w/c 0.5 (note: batch water 241 / binder 418 ~ 0.58; reported design w/c 0.5). RHA-O fixed at 17.5% of cement; CWRT replaces fine aggregate by volume at 0/5/10/15%. Mortar series (Table 2) and high-temperature data also in paper but strengths figure-only. Optimal: 17.5% RHA-O + 5% CWRT comparable comp + higher split than control.
